headline.text: L3 S3 X-ray detected *nail* inside finished pouch—rejected successfully, MD missed during changeover clean.

summary: Two active food-safety events: nail found in L3 S3 pouch (X-ray caught, MD did not), and L3 S3 metal detector skipped during changeover. Three sanitation gaps across L3 lines required rework. One L2 FFS pallet discovered outside system control.

holds.title: FFS pallet missing from system
holds.summary: LPN R473833 (Item 21139) discovered in staging after inventory but never entered into WMS—disposition pending.
holds.status: Open, pending investigation into which shift consumed or why not logged.

food_safety.title: Metal detector skipped in changeover
food_safety.summary: L3 S3 metal detector found full of chocolate at startup—cleaning step missed during NIC changeover.
food_safety.status: Resolved—line paused, MD cleaned out before production resumed.

food_safety.title: Nail detected in finished pouch
food_safety.summary: X-ray at L3 S3 MM4 rejected one pouch containing a nail at 10:41 MT—metal detector upstream did not catch.
food_safety.status: Resolved—pouch rejected, investigation open on MD sensitivity.

sanitation.title: Allergen swab failure on shakers
sanitation.summary: L3 ML1 shakers area failed allergen test at 09:31 MT—re-cleaned and passed on second attempt.

sanitation.title: PTL components not cleaned before install
sanitation.summary: L3 ML1 PTL filter gasket, base, and pipe had hardened chocolate when moved from washroom to line for installation.
sanitation.status: Resolved—parts sent back for cleaning before installation.

sanitation.title: Metaquat in cage not visible to operators
sanitation.summary: L1 S2 kitchen used Metaquat from cage but operators reported not seeing it initially—chemical control gap.

sanitation.title: Cold stamps found dirty at ML4
sanitation.summary: L3 ML4 cold stamps discovered dirty during changeover setup—washed before use.
sanitation.status: Resolved—stamps washed, passed visual and ATP.

opportunities.text: Consider adding PTL filter gasket, base, and pipe to ML1 cleaning checklist—today's parts arrived at install with hardened chocolate still present.
Review S3 changeover checklist to ensure metal detector cleaning is verified before startup—MD was found full of chocolate this morning.
Consider adding mixer auger emptying step to ML1 end-of-run checklist—excess chocolate inside auger increased cleaning time and difficulty today.
